messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM for the KV-cache incident — we need to lock owners and timelines for the postmortem actions. I sketched a short handover + escalation plan below.

maria: Actions (short):
- owner: who picks the root cause ticket + ETA
- jira: create tickets for code fix, infra hardening, monitoring
- raci: assign R/A/C/I for each ticket
- handoff: who'll pair with oncall for rollout and verification

kevin: I can take the 'code fix' ticket (INFRA-4321), target EOD Thu for a patch.

sanjay: I will own infra hardening (INFRA-4322). ETA next sprint. I'll add config for stricter eviction thresholds.

emma: I'll handle monitoring/alerts (INFRA-4323) — will add histograms for TTL and a dashboard. Aim to have alert runbook updated by Wed.

maria: Thanks. Can folks paste the ticket links so we can attach to the postmortem doc? Also we need RACI quickly: who is accountable vs responsible vs consult?

kevin: R=kevin, A=maria, C=sanjay, I=oncall.

sanjay: R=sanjay, A=maria, C=kevin, I=platform eng.

emma: R=emma, A=maria, C=SDR, I=cs (for customer comms).

maria: Notes:
- If patch causes degradation we have an escalation path: revert -> throttle -> rollback routing to older model shard. Lia-bot will create an incident if latency > 450ms for 3m.

lia-bot: [automated] Created ticket INFRA-4321, INFRA-4322, INFRA-4323 and linked to PM-POST-778.

kevin: linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4321 (code fix)

sanjay: infra: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4322

emma: monitoring: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4323

maria: Can we add a small regression test to catch the eviction pattern? low-cost synthetic that runs every hour. Who can own that?

kevin: I can add the synthetic test, will PR by tomorrow.

maria: Great — final ask: please add ETA + PR links to the postmortem doc (PM-POST-778) and mark items with due dates. We'll do a quick handoff review Fri 10:30am.

emma: ack, will update runbook and post PR link here. :thumbsup:

sanjay: ack, will scope the infra ticket and map rollback steps into runbook.

kevin: ack on PR + pairing with oncall for rollout.

maria: Thanks team — tagging follow-up owners in the doc. I’ll ping owners in the doc on Wednesday morning for status.
